reference.reuse: detector thresholds and penalty are reused verbatim
reference.adaptation: the detector is applied to every complete model-native progressive-generation boundary window; boundaries are reconstructed from frozen native generation-unit geometry; aggregation is boundary-mean within case then equal-case mean

detector.sampling: boundary-aligned native-frame phase, then 8 FPS; every full video is decoded once

wan_block3_16fps.geometry: Wan temporal VAE yields 4*n-3 frames for the first 3-latent block and 4*n frames for later cached blocks

omniforcing_ltx2_24fps.geometry: LTX-2 first block has 4 latent frames and later blocks have 3; the first block decodes to 1+(4-1)*8=25 frames and cached later blocks contribute 24 frames

inapplicable_methods.pixverse-r1: model-native video boundaries are not observable through the commercial interface
